responsibility: This generator reads target define_insn and define_expand patterns and emits insn-codes.h, the enum insn_code namespace that assigns CODE_FOR_* values to named machine-description patterns. It preserves entries even for conditionally-elided patterns by mapping unavailable ones to CODE_FOR_nothing, and it provides the canonical numeric instruction-code table and NUM_INSN_CODES constant used by recognizers, emitters, and optab initialization.
